requires.n: Legendary Creature with Flying and MV >= 4

2533-5925-8095--70.description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the legendary creature with flying.
When the creature dies, Jackdaw Savior triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning the legendary creature with flying from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3899-6972-7782.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Clockwork Hydra.
When Clockwork Hydra dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-4365-7858.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Hollowhenge Overlord triggers, creating six 2/2 Wolf creature tokens for each Wolf and/or Werewolf you control due to Ojer Taq and Mondrak.
Repeat step 1 during each of your upkeeps. You'll create exponentially more Wolves each time assuming the Wolf tokens survive.
1270-4365-7858.notes: The number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you'll control after performing steps 1 and 2 is equal to 7^X * Y, where X is the number of iterations of those steps you've performed (starting at 1), and Y is the initial number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you started with. So if you start with 6 creatures, you'll have 42 after the first iteration, 294 after the second, and so on. This also assumes no Wolves and/or Werewolves die, and no more are created during the turns.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1849-3259-7795.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1849-3259-7795.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Drider, triggering Breath of Fury and Drider.
Resolve the Drider trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

851-4659-5086-5183-7743.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
851-4659-5086-5183-7743.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with four or more quest counters on it

2104-7012-7722.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Airbender Ascension.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Temporal Manipulation from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

628-2438-7219.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing The Reaper.
When The Reaper dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When The Reaper enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability
Repeat.

2438-4316-4871-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
2438-4316-4871-5220.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

2034-5170-6132-6273.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Embalmed Ascendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Embalmed Ascendant trigger.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a charge counter on it

2024-5115-6602.notablePrerequisites: You have had five nontoken creatures enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
2024-5115-6602.description:
Activate Tromell by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to put at least five charge counters on Gemstone Array.
Activate Gemstone Array five times by removing five charge counters from it, adding {3}{G}{W}.
Activate Seedcradle Witch by paying {2}{G}{W}, untapping Tromell and giving it +3/+3 until end of turn
Repeat.

2034-4763--21--45.description:
Activate the Equipment by paying its equip cost, attaching it to the creature that is castable for {C}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Koll triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2034-5220-5477-6441-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-5220-5477-6441-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating two creature tokens and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

985-5051-5078-5268.description:
Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

4474-5051-5078-6766.description:
Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

539-2438-5649-6517.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters, Dragonback Assault triggers, as Bladewing's Thrall is a land due to Ashaya.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a 4/4 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

7-586-5258-5618-6797.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature(s) that each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
7-586-5258-5618-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

4222-4289-6702.description:
Activate Kilo by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Kilo.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent

3951-3975-4192-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability twice.
Resolve a Altaïr trigger, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Resolve the other Altaïr trigger, creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Put either Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, triggering the other Éomer token, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

1563-2457-4772-4885.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

372-2417-2556.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Siren's Ruse exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Mnemonic Wall exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Siren's Ruse.
372-2417-2556.description:
Cast Siren's Ruse by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Mnemonic Wall and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Mnemonic Wall trigger.
Resolve the Mnemonic Wall trigger, returning Siren's Ruse from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Siren's Ruse.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Mnemonic Wall and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

176-5231-5522.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one other non-Spirit creature.
176-5231-5522.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing any other non-Spirit creature, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token that enters the battlefield as a copy of Essence of the Wild.
Repeat.

1350-4094-4231-5444.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
1350-4094-4231-5444.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Cast Carnage Interpreter by paying {1}{B/R}{B/R}.
When Carnage Interpreter enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating eight Clue, Food and Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate six Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{W}{B/R}{B/R}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Carnage Interpreter to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1020-1117-1913-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver to your hand from your graveyard.
Imotekh the Stormlord's first ability triggers, creating two 2/2 Necron Warrior artifact creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Necron Warrior, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {3}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Junk Diver, adding {C}{C}.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever to your hand from your graveyard.
Imotekh the Stormlord's first ability triggers, creating two 2/2 Necron Warrior artifact creature tokens.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {2}.
Repeat.

914-1368-3698-5231.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three additional cards in your graveyard if Dockside Extortionist is in your graveyard.
Opponents control at least two artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1368-3698-5231.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist either from your hand by paying {1}{R} or from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {1}{R} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least two Treasure tokens.
The Treasures enter the battlefield, triggering Grinding Station that many times, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by sacrificing a Treasure, causing you to mill three cards.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, adding {R}.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.
If opponents control three or more artifacts/enchantments, this combo will net near-infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

1823-2584-2864-4050.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature with toughness six or less.
You do not control an Army.
1823-2584-2864-4050.description:
Activate That Which Was Taken by paying {4} and tapping it, putting a divinity counter on a creature an opponent controls with toughness six or less.
Activate Fall of Cair Andros by paying {7}{R}, dealing seven damage to the creature that has a divinity counter on it.
Fall of Cair Andros triggers, creating a 0/0 Army and putting at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
When the Army enters the battlefield, Pandemonium triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Army, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Pandemonium trigger, dealing 1 damage to the creature with a divinity counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite mana, with a Pandemonium trigger on the stack, you may use Fall of Cair Andros' ability to deal infinite damage to the creature with a divinity counter on it, thus causing the Army to have infinite +1/+1 counters on it, which causes the Pandemonium trigger to deal infinite damage to any target.

841-2438-3585-4544.notablePrerequisites:
You don't control a Ring-bearer.
You have a land card in hand.
841-2438-3585-4544.description:
Play a land card, triggering Dúnedain Rangers and Greensleeves.
Resolve the Greensleeves trigger, creating a 3/3 Badger creature token.
Resolve the Dúnedain Rangers trigger, causing the Ring to tempt you, and causing the Badger token to become your Ring-bearer.
Sméagol triggers.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Badger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Resolve the Sméagol trigger, causing an opponent to reveal cards from the top of their library until they reveal a land card, then causing you to put the land onto the battlefield tapped under your control, and your opponent to put all other revealed cards into their graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Dúnedain Rangers and Greensleeves trigger.
Repeat from step 2.
NOTE: This combo can be stopped if an opponent runs out of lands in their library, so it is recommended to alternate opponents in between cycles to maximize the amount of iterations.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-2020-2100.notablePrerequisites: Vadrik has a power of four or greater.
392-2020-2100.description:
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Resolve Searing Touch, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning it to your hand.
Repeat.

589-1017.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
589-1017.description:
Draw a card.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fathom Mage.
Fathom Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

404-1521-1849-2105.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
404-1521-1849-2105.description:
Declare Flamerush Rider, Combat Celebrant and Ghired as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant, Ghired's second ability and Flamerush Rider trigger.
Resolve the Flamerush Rider trigger, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant that is tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Ghired trigger, creating a copy of the Combat Celebrant token.
Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase, and declare the Combat Celebrant token created in step 4 and Ghired as attackers, choosing to exert the Combat Celebrant token as it attacks.
Repeat from step 4.
Optionally, you may also attack with Flamerush Rider to get infinite copies of any other attacking creatures you control.

914-1214-3198.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1214-3198.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Cast Lore Drakkis for its mutate cost by paying {U/R}{U/R}, targeting Dockside Extortionist.
Lore Drakkis's mutate ability triggers, returning Silent Departure from your graveyard to hand.
Cast Silent Departure by paying {U}, returning Dockside Extortionist and Lore Drakkis to your hand.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing those, adding {1}{U}{U/R}{U/R}{R}.
Repeat.
